A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Test-Time Matching work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices are readable, and corresponding material can be matched despite renumbering and relocation.

before.justification: v1 reports original SimpleMatch and TTM benchmark evaluations, global-matching experiments, and ablations in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds SmolVLM adaptation results and evaluations with fewer TTM iterations.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and the local/global matching procedures remain unchanged. Section 4.3 adds a generative-model adaptation that trains on Yes/No pseudo-labels, constructing negative responses from mismatched image-caption pairs within each group.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same five benchmarks and 16 dataset variants, including grouped and non-grouped settings. The added SmolVLM and iteration-budget experiments reuse existing image-caption matching coverage.

E2.justification: v2 Table 2 adds raw SmolVLM-256M-Instruct and its SimpleMatch results as comparators to TTM on three benchmarks. Existing CLIP, SigLIP, and GPT-4.1 comparisons remain intact; newly cited test-time adaptation methods are not evaluated.

E3.justification: The new SmolVLM experiment uses three iterations, ten epochs per iteration, and group batch sizes of 16 or 32. Appendix B.3 also introduces SigLIP evaluations with three and five total iterations. Existing experimental settings and evaluation metrics are retained.

E4.justification: New Appendix B.3 and Table 11 test sensitivity to the total adaptation budget by comparing three, five, and ten iterations on three benchmarks. Existing threshold-schedule, initial-threshold, matching-alternative, and oracle analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions state that results are averaged over four random runs with standard deviations. The added tables follow that convention without introducing new uncertainty procedures, significance tests, or changed run counts.

E6.justification: v2 Table 2 newly reports SmolVLM TTM accuracies of 63.38, 81.67, and 85.17 on Winoground, MMVP-VLM, and ColorSwap, respectively, versus SimpleMatch scores of 61.75, 76.30, and 80.00. Table 11 adds three- and five-iteration SigLIP results. All corresponding pre-existing result tables and plotted findings are retained.

T1.justification: Propositions 1–4, metric definitions, and Appendix A proofs are unchanged. Section 3.2 and Appendix B.3 add a complexity argument deriving O(T·Cft) runtime from matching costs and the assumption that finetuning dominates for small groups.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction newly claim that iterative TTM improves a generative multimodal model, whereas v1 applied TTM to contrastive models and SimpleMatch to GPT-4.1. The principal benchmark-record and broad-applicability claims remain.

C2.justification: v2 replaces v1's acceptance of GroupScore as a valid evaluation choice with a sharper argument that its constraints unnecessarily reject correct matchings. It also expands the false-positive/false-negative explanation of threshold schedules, notes that short benchmark captions may suit generative models poorly, and argues runtime comparability with existing test-time training.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 and Appendix B.1 newly document the SmolVLM prompt, negative-example construction, training budget, batch sizes, learning rates, and threshold schedules. Existing contrastive-model settings, augmentation instructions, and the code-access link are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to TENT, Contrastive Test-Time Adaptation, LoRA, and SmolVLM. The established positioning relative to test-time training, self-training, and active learning remains; the removed methods-section comparison largely duplicates material retained in Section 5.

P1.justification: v2 makes targeted abstract, introduction, and discussion revisions, expands the threshold explanation, and removes a redundant related-work paragraph. It adds Section 4.3 and Appendix B.3, subdivides implementation details, and adds acknowledgments while preserving the overall narrative structure.

P2.justification: v2 adds tables for SmolVLM results, SmolVLM hyperparameters, and iteration-budget results. Existing tables are retained and renumbered; figures are preserved with sizing adjustments, and Figure 4 and several tables move within the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly strengthens the paper by demonstrating actual TTM adaptation on a generative model, documenting that setup, and testing the accuracy tradeoff from fewer iterations. These additions address applicability and computational-budget questions while retaining the earlier evidence. The extension covers one small generative model, and runtime comparability is argued analytically rather than established through timing measurements, limiting the improvement's scope.
